title: Use Aveva API tote management to view current tote task status
summary: Use the Aveva API tote management page’s “Get Tote Task” function to retrieve the current status of totes and the list of tasks for those totes, so you can understand what is happening with tote movement.
when_to_use: When you need to see the current tote task status (tote status and the tasks list) from the Aveva API tote management interface to understand tote movement context.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the Aveva API tote management “Get Tote Task” query and interpret the returned tote status and task list to determine which tote/task context needs follow-up.
access_or_tools_needed: Aveva API page for tote management (“API Features for Tote Management”)
“Get Tote Task” function on that page

access_required: Access to the Aveva API tote management page (“API Features for Tote Management”)

visual_references.description: Aveva API tote management page showing “API Features for Tote Management” including “Get Tote Task” (and related tote actions).
Frame around the “Get Tote Task” section/control on the Aveva API tote management page.
Frame showing the “Tote Tasks” interface fields (e.g., Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, Task Name, Tote Error).

steps.title: Open the Aveva API page for tote management (“API Features for Tote Management”).
steps.purpose: Get to the tote management interface that contains the “Get Tote Task” function.
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Aveva API tote management page labeled “API Features for Tote Management” and locate the “Get Tote Task” function on that page.
steps.expected_result: The “Get Tote Task” function is visible on the Aveva API tote management page.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the “Get Tote Task” entry on the “API Features for Tote Management” list.
steps.failure_condition: The “Get Tote Task” function is not visible on the tote management page (or the page does not load).

actions.label: Locate Get Tote Task
actions.exact_action: Find the “Get Tote Task” function on the “API Features for Tote Management” page.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot locate “Get Tote Task” on the Aveva API tote management page, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/API features list includes “Get Tote Task — Retrieves the current tote task”.
Aveva API page lists API Features for Tote Management including “Get Tote Task”.

steps.title: Use the “Get Tote Task” function to retrieve the current tote task information.
steps.purpose: Pull the current tote status and the list of tasks for totes from the system.
steps.instruction: Run the “Get Tote Task” function from the Aveva API tote management page to retrieve the current tote task information.
steps.expected_result: The API returns current tote task information showing the current status of totes and their tasks.
steps.healthy_condition: A response is returned from “Get Tote Task” (i.e., you receive tote task data rather than an error/no data).
steps.failure_condition: The “Get Tote Task” call returns no data or an error.

actions.label: Run Get Tote Task
actions.exact_action: Use “Get Tote Task” to retrieve the current tote task.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the API returns no data or an error, stop and escalate to support.
Do not proceed with recovery actions (resend/exchange) without confirming the tote/task context from “Get Tote Task”.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Get Tote Task — Retrieves the current tote task”.

steps.title: Review the returned data for tote status and the list of tasks for the totes.
steps.purpose: Extract the observable tote/task context from the “Get Tote Task” response.
steps.instruction: In the “Tote Tasks” results, review the returned fields that describe tote status and task details.
steps.expected_result: You can see tote task data including tote status and a list of tasks for totes.
steps.healthy_condition: The results include tote/task rows with fields such as Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, Task Name, and Tote Error.
steps.failure_condition: The results do not include tote/task rows or key fields (e.g., Tote Id / Task id / Tote Error) needed to identify tote/task context.

actions.label: Inspect tote task fields
actions.exact_action: Review the returned “Tote Tasks” fields for tote status and tasks.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the returned data is missing or incomplete such that you cannot identify the tote/task context, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Tote Tasks interface provides information such as Tote Id, AGV Id, Original Destination, Station, Task id, Task Name, and Tote Error.
Transcript: “Get tote task shows you what the current status of the totes, all their tasks.”

steps.title: Use the retrieved status to identify which tote/task needs further action.
steps.purpose: Determine the specific tote/task context that would be the target for any subsequent tote actions (e.g., resend/exchange) while ensuring you have confirmed context first.
steps.instruction: Based on the “Get Tote Task” results (tote status and task list), identify the tote/task that requires follow-up.
steps.expected_result: You can point to a specific tote/task context from the returned data (e.g., by Tote Id and Task id) that would be used for any next action.
steps.healthy_condition: The returned data clearly indicates the tote’s current status and the associated tasks (including whether there is a Tote Error).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot identify a specific tote/task context from the results (e.g., no clear Tote Id/Task id pairing).

actions.label: Identify target tote/task
actions.exact_action: Use the returned tote status and task list to identify which tote/task needs further action.
